credential_scan.scope: Pattern scan of packaged text and PowerPoint XML; not a guarantee against every secret format. Credential stores and local environment state excluded.

test_execution: Executed from submission/server using the existing Python 3.13 environment, -B -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider. This verifies the copied source; it is not a clean-environment dependency installation test.
scope_notes: Local package only; not uploaded or submitted.
Historical evaluation results are preserved, not newly executed.
Archived evaluation runners can require original paths, traces and authorized workspace access.
Latest model-driven probes are blocked by the provider credential; no new MLflow score is claimed.
